en.name: Baojun
en.ability: Each night*, choose up to two players: they die. The number of players you choose cannot be the same as the number of players who died last night (if more than two, count as two).

zh.name: 暴君
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你可以选择至多两名玩家：他们死亡。你选择的玩家数量不能与上个夜晚死亡的玩家数量相同（超过二人时算作二人）。
